{{Quote|In the final years of the reign of Ajunta Pall, five Dark Lords explored the machine&mdash;the Wraith Box. One burned in purple flame, another vanished from sight. Two brothers slew each other&mdash;and only one Sith returned to Korriban.|The Chronicles of Lord Skaysh|<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Unintended Consequences|[[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]}}</ref>}}
'''Skaysh''' was a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who wrote the [[Chronicles of Lord Skaysh]], [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] texts that contained legends about the Sith [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Ajunta Pall]]. The legend of the [[Wraith Box]] was one such story in the chronicles.
